meta.question: do reported flood locations sit in terrain lows and modelled flow paths more than comparable places? - now asked against geography-controlled and neighbourhood-matched controls

sources.dem_primary: FABDEM V1-2 (Forest And Buildings removed Copernicus DEM; Hawker, Uhe, Paulo, Sosa, Savage, Sampson, Neal 2022, Environmental Research Letters https://doi.org/10.1088/1748-9326/ac4d4f), University of Bristol data.bris repository, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
sources.dem_comparison: Copernicus GLO-30 DSM (Copernicus DEM, Airbus Defence and Space / ESA, 2022_02 release as distributed in the public AWS 'copernicus-dem-30m' bucket); contains buildings and vegetation.

water_lagoon_sea.sea: OSM natural=coastline via Overpass, rasterized with the lagoon polygons

sources.builtup_2020_matching: GHS-BUILT-S R2023A E2020, CC BY 4.0 (European Union, GHSL R2023A, GHS-BUILT-S)
sources.land_mask: ESA WorldCover 10 m v200 (2021), CC BY 4.0 (ESA WorldCover 10 m v200, 2021)

meta.fabdem_note: FABDEM V1-2 fetched from the Hugging Face mirror links-ads/fabdem-v12 (public bucket links-ads/fabdem, reprocessed and hosted by Fondazione LINKS) after data.bris refused every request.  The mirror README names FABDEM v1.2, the University of Bristol and the authors (Hawker, Uhe, Paulo, Sosa, Savage, Sampson, Neal 2022), and states that tiles are the Bristol distribution rewritten into COGs with pixel values unchanged.  The mirror README cites the Non-Commercial Government Licence v2.0 while data.bris publishes the dataset as CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; both are non-commercial.  Tile container checks, sha256 hashes and a value cross-check against GLO-30 are recorded in meta.fabdem_mirror.

value_check_vs_glo30.note: point-sampled land cells (GHSL cell defined), FABDEM minus GLO-30; FABDEM removes buildings/trees, so it should sit at or below GLO-30, most visibly in built-up cells

method.outlet_burning: lagoon/sea rasterized from OSM polygons and set to (min land elevation - 10) m; rim water cells set 5 m lower so border-touching water bodies drain
method.depressions: priority-flood fill (pysheds 0.5 fill_pits + fill_depressions); depth = filled - DEM on land; depression mask = depth >= {0.25, 0.5, 1.0} m and >= 3 connected cells (8-neighbourhood); FABDEM vertical error is ~2 m in cities, so 0.25 m is optimistic and 1.0 m is conservative
method.routing: D8 on the flat-resolved conditioned surface (pysheds resolve_flats, Barnes et al. 2015); flow accumulation in cells
method.hand: HAND via pysheds compute_hand (Nobre-style: elevation minus the elevation of the drainage cell at the end of the D8 flow path); drainage = accumulation >= 0.25/1/4 km2 (primary 1 km2), and lagoon/sea cells are terminal drainage so that cells draining straight into water are defined; mapped waterways were NOT burned in (kept only for distance-to-water)
method.tpi_500: elevation minus mean land elevation within 500 m (FFT disk mean)
method.metrics_window: per point, metrics computed within a radius matched to location confidence: street/point/exact 150 m, neighbourhood 750 m, over land cells only

designs.builtup_only: Task 24's controls: up to 20 random land points anywhere in the AOI, GHSL built-up 2020 within +/- 0.05 of the point's 1 km cell; numbers kept from the Task 24 run itself
designs.matched_water: as builtup_only, plus distance to lagoon/sea within +/- 25% of the point's (minimum +/- 500 m)
designs.local: up to 20 random land points in a 1-3 km annulus around each point, GHSL built-up 2020 within +/- 0.1 (widened to +/- 0.15 only where fewer than 10 candidates existed; widened points in meta.designs_meta.local.widened_points)
designs.shared_rules: all designs: land candidates only (not water), never within 1000 m of any kept evidence point, evaluated at the same window radius as their point

method.test: stratified permutation (within-stratum label exchange), 10,000 shuffles, seed 20261018; statistic = median over points of (point metric - median of its matched controls); raw and Holm-corrected p-values reported for the 4 primary metrics per DEM x design x subset

subsets.far_from_water_gt2km: points > 2000 m from lagoon/sea (tide cannot be the explanation)

primary_metrics.elevation_demoted: elev_min is descriptive only: the AOI reaches Ogun State and the Epe/Badagry hinterland, so AOI-wide elevation differences mostly separate the low coastal city from the interior, not local lows within a neighbourhood
primary_metrics.effect_scale: every median difference is also reported as diff_over_2m, in units of the ~2 m DEM vertical error, so local signals can be read against DEM noise
primary_metrics.multiple_testing: Holm correction across the 4 primary metrics, per DEM x design x subset

as_run.fabdem: task 24b run (numbers preserved from the previous events/terrain_check.json)
as_run.glo30: task 24b run (numbers preserved from the previous events/terrain_check.json)

verdict_rule.pass: in the local design, at least 2 of the 4 primary metrics are significant after Holm (p < 0.05) in the predicted direction for the all-points subset, and at least one of those is also significant in the far_from_water_gt2km subset
verdict_rule.fail: none of the 4 primary metrics significant after Holm in the local design
verdict_rule.note: the verdict is written for every design, but the local design decides; with both DEMs, the primary DEM (FABDEM) decides

evidence_filtering.rule: Task 16: location_confidence 'lga' dropped; duplicates within 200 m in the same event removed (first kept)

caveats: Lagos is extremely flat and 30 m DEM vertical error is ~2 m, so HAND and depression values are relative indicators, not depth predictions

HAND can be negative where a cell drains into a drainage cell that sits higher in the raw DEM - i.e. inside a filled depression below its outlet; the more negative, the deeper the modelled depression, so min HAND and the depression-share metrics partly measure the same thing
GLO-30 contains interpolation artifacts over the open lagoon (values up to ~58 m over water); those cells are masked as water and burned to the outlet constant, so they never enter land metrics
GLO-30 is a DSM: buildings add spurious relief; FABDEM removes buildings and trees but its own bare-earth surface is smoothed
evidence points are mostly neighbourhood centroids, not the flooded spot

builtup_only controls are matched on built-up level only; matched_water adds distance to lagoon/sea and 'local' restricts to the point's own 1-3 km neighbourhood; population density and drainage investment remain unmeasured confounders in every design

elevation is confounded by geography: the AOI includes Ogun State and the Epe/Badagry hinterland, so elev_min is descriptive only and the Task 24 17 m elevation gap says 'low coastal city', not 'local low'
the local signals are small next to the ~2 m DEM vertical error: read diff_over_2m next to every p-value, not just the p-value
p-values are Holm-corrected across the 4 primary metrics per design x subset; uncorrected scanning of 9 metrics x 3 subsets x 3 designs would overstate significance
HAND treats lagoon/sea as terminal drainage; near-shore HAND is height above the water body rather than above a modelled stream
a positive result earns the right to model forward, it does not identify which human action caused any individual flood
